# Upstream's docker run also gives --stop-timeout=10s; the compose file's stop_grace_period is dropped by import (Incus has no such option), so it is left out here.
--name qbittorrent
-e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e WEBUI_PORT=8080 -e TORRENTING_PORT=6881
-p 8080:8080 -p 6881:6881 -p 6881:6881/udp
-v /path/to/qbittorrent/appdata:/config -v /path/to/downloads:/downloads
--restart unless-stopped
lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
